Title: Azure Security Center: Public preview updates for July 2021

Body.Content:
In July 2021, the following public preview updates and enhancements were made to Azure Security Center:

  • Azure Sentinel connector now includes optional bi-directional alert synchronization (in preview)
  • 'Compliance over time' workbook template added to Azure Monitor Workbooks gallery (in preview)
